design.title: Collaboration history and partner choice
design.researchQuestion: How does prior collaboration change selection of the designated partner?
design.decisionTask: Choose a partner for the next project, or state that no preference is supported.
design.x0: The firm has not collaborated with the designated partner.
design.x1: The firm has successfully collaborated with the designated partner.
sharedFacts: Both partners can complete the project.
The project has a fixed budget.
baselineFacts: Both partners quote the same price.
Both partners meet the technical requirements.
assumptions: Partner selection is a narrow proxy; it does not measure long-term performance.
sourceNotes: This offline fixture is researcher-written and contains no paper evidence.

measurement.measuredProxy: Selection of this designated action: Select the designated partner.
measurement.x0: The firm has not collaborated with the designated partner.
measurement.x1: The firm has successfully collaborated with the designated partner.
measurement.contrast: X1 minus X0 in the rate of selecting the designated action; use display.contrastPercentagePoints for percentage points.
measurement.denominator: All accepted decisions in that X condition, including equivalent and insufficient-information responses.
measurement.neutralMeaning: Equivalent and insufficient-information are distinct no-preference responses; neither is a selection of the alternative action.
measurement.scope: A narrow binary decision proxy in an LLM vignette; not a measurement of the full original outcome or a human causal estimate.
